alex_k: Heads-up — seeing a sustained spike of 504s from hosted inference (eu-west) starting ~08:12 UTC. P95 token latency jumped and a bunch of requests hit gateway timeouts. incident-bot: Alert: hosted-inference-euwest-504-rate > 200/min :rotating_light: priya_m: opening warroom, tagging ops/sre/support. Samir, can you grab runtime traces? samir_ops: looking. Initial hypothesis: auth token refresh path is thundering during short-lived tokens; auth-proxy started returning 503s and gateway propagated 504s. Carla_support: multiple customers reported client timeouts and one billing alert — they hit client SDK retries. customer reported curl got 504 consistently. alex_k: paste of a repro curl we captured: ```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <short-token>" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
* TCP_NODELAY set
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
< x-request-id: 7e9a1f23
``` helena_sre: seeing auth-proxy logs: a flood of `refresh_token` calls with identical kid header, auth-proxy rate-limited KMS and started returning 503s. Trace snippet: ```
[2026-03-10T08:12:34Z] auth-proxy ERROR refresh_token failed: KMS throttle (429) trace=7e9a1f23
[2026-03-10T08:12:35Z] gateway WARN upstream timeout for request 7e9a1f23
``` samir_ops: mitigation steps live: 1) disabled gateway retry-on-504 to avoid retry storm 2) bumped auth-proxy local cache TTL to 10m (from 30s) 3) temporarily increased auth-proxy concurrency limit to 200 (was 50) — rolling back if we see issues. matt_devex: pushed quick patch to SDK to jitter retries client-side to reduce synchronized refreshes (canary). carla_support: customer comms drafted, telling impacted tenants we mitigated and asking for SDK update. priya_m: good — let's keep a concise action list. alex_k: Action items: - [ ] samir_ops: revert auth-proxy concurrency tweak to safe-value after observation window (due EOD UTC) - [ ] matt_devex: release SDK jitter patch and notify client teams (due +48h) - [ ] helena_sre: add circuit-breaker at gateway for auth-proxy 5xx to fail fast (owner helena_sre, due +3d) - [ ] alex_k: write incident postmortem and link playbook updates (due +2d) samir_ops: notes for postmortem — root cause likely short token TTL + recent change that removed local caching on auth-proxy (deployed yesterday). That exposed KMS and auth-proxy to refresh storms under bursty workloads. matt_devex: SDK uptake note — we'll add default backoff jitter in next minor release. carla_support: compiling list of impacted accounts -> sending to sales & cs. incident-bot: Warroom closed at 09:35 UTC after metrics stabilized, remaining mitigations scheduled as follow-up. alex_k: I'll draft the postmortem now and include timeline and reverted commits. priya_m: please include regression test for token refresh bursts in the CI evals. helena_sre: I'll add a synthetic test hitting refresh path with randomized timing. samir_ops: also recommend an observability alert for auth-proxy refresh_rate per-second > 50 to trigger early mitigation. alex_k: thanks team. Follow-up note (2026-03-11): alex_k: posted postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/pm/postmortems/1758502468-auth-refresh-race DRAFT — please review. matt_devex: reviewed and left comments about SDK rollout plan. carla_support: confirmed impacted customers have been messaged. priya_m: closing thread, will track remaining action items in the incident board. :white_check_mark:
